adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on failed validation (`handleAdd`), but on a successful mutation (`addGuestsMutation.onSuccess`) the code only calls `setIsOpenDialog(false)` and `setMultiEmailValue([""])` and never resets `isInvalidEmail` back to `false`. Since the component remains mounted (it’s always rendered in `BookingListItem` and controlled via `Dialog open={isOpenDialog}`), reopening the dialog after a prior validation error will still render the red warning banner over the reset form.
